lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits, characterized by vertical columns of 4-5 units and relatively equidistant horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that cross horizontal rows of spots, forming high-contrast anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature on the upper lateral flank showing a sharp vertical transition from high-luminance (top) to shadow (bottom), extending towards the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 5-8 high-luminance blobs distributed irregularly within the boundary of the first dorsal fin, primarily localized to the lower anterior and central regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible indentation or notch on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; faint irregular darker markings visible on the lower ventral-lateral region near the pelvic fin.
